notes.title: New Fun Mode (featuring Endless Challenge) & Gameplay Optimizations
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added Endless Challenge sub-mode within Fun Mode: Survive in a single life. Recommended for players familiar with level layouts.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented No-Digging Zones: Digging is now disabled inside rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Character Hit State: Slightly increased the character's initial movement speed and dodge roll distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Monster Attack Range.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Statement Regarding Antivirus False Positives for Some Players
notes.content: [list][*][p]We have promptly submitted the game's source files to multiple authoritative security platforms for verification. The results confirm that the game is completely safe, and you may continue playing with full confidence. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]To enhance your experience, we will release the first minor update within a week, introducing a new  mode. [/p][/*][*][p]Our team will actively monitor community feedback, and highly upvoted suggestions from the comments section will be prioritized for implementation in future updates.[/p][/*][*][p]We sincerely appreciate your understanding and ongoing support![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602942/024f6fb2101184ad52762f745b27db1cd38ea3d9.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]
